name: SHADOWS
full_name: Search for Hidden And Dark Objects With the SPS
summary: SHADOWS is a named, unimplemented dark-sector proposal for the CERN SPS North Area ECN3 site. Its archival value is retained without counting it as an operating experiment.
detection_principle: A proposed off-axis decay volume and magnetic spectrometer near a 400 GeV proton beam dump would search for visible long-lived decays of weakly coupled particles.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
